title: Correct the Tris hydrochloride salt proposal parent grade before native publication
body:
The isolated Worker05 `CHEM-C1193-Tris-HCl-salt` proposal stores cas:1185-53-1 as the crystalline salt identity but grades its stated parent CHEBI:9754 tris as BROAD_MATCH. Under MAPPING_SEMANTICS§1/§3, the salt is the narrower supplied form; the intended asymmetric parent grounding requires NARROW_MATCH. This is a record-grade defect, not a generator defect.

Exact source: Worker05 published43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d, `correction-1193-v1/chemicals/proposed/Tris_Hydrochloride_Salt.yaml`, SHA256945bd8da0c00306c5e0d9ad2c3eaead1fb3af33e89cdc2e3440e729ec5763c58; intended destination `data/ingredients/mapped/Tris_Hydrochloride_Salt.yaml`. Finding W01-PREP-B-003 was independently reproduced in memory using the exact pinned Claw76c1ebeea3fc7f80bf1abe044688f298f390cfac builder (SHA25638d59f42953305f6fc51e4fc24dfc59ee1919bfb961595b67a8afe9f8a46a1bc), without a maintained write.

| Exact native projection | Parent row | Registry identities |
|---|---|---|
| Current BROAD_MATCH | closeMatch CHEBI:9754 | exactMatch cas:1185-53-1 |
| Only grade changed in memory to NARROW_MATCH | broadMatch CHEBI:9754 | exactMatch cas:1185-53-1 and native RuleB1 kgmicrobe.compound:tris_hydrochloride_salt |

The corrected native output also retains the CAS display token on registry rows rather than on the asymmetric parent row. Therefore re-review the complete three-row output, not just a predicate-cell substitution. Preserve the salt CAS, source-form evidence, all authentic history, and the seven exact weighed-reagent contexts separately from the larger16-occurrence case; do not approve stock/ambiguous contexts wholesale. Append a truthful grade correction in a new isolated successor and independently validate its exact output. Reassess exact-term priority if new evidence warrants it; do not change the generator, schema, thresholds, tests or global BROAD_MATCH meaning to fit this one proposal.

Primary supplied-salt evidence: [manufacturer Trizma hydrochloride document](https://www.sigmaaldrich.cn/deepweb/assets/sigmaaldrich/product/documents/137/329/t3253pis.pdf). Full probe, original/control rows and pins: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/family-findings-triage-v1/native-tris-predicate-reproduction-v1.json`.

Dedup:696 is the broader grade audit,884 the schema/semantics discrepancy,1164 the distinct tomato-juice proposal. None is this exact Tris salt correction. The Worker05 full review's18 retained findings do not already contain it. No source or canonical change has been applied by this review.

title: Reconcile source-bound preparation families before installing duplicate or unsupported owners
body:
The completed independent preparation-comparison packets identify duplicate proposed preparations, source-continuity conflicts and unsupported claims of disjointness. This issue tracks only the bounded family decisions below. These are isolated proposals; no record merge, new namespace, scientific approval or export release is authorized by the review.

All three sealed packets were independently hash-checked: Worker01 878 files, Worker05 390, Worker10 526, with no hash mismatch or unlisted file in the ignored-inclusive inventories. Their assignments partition the 67 mechanical family leads (26/22/19); this means comparison coverage, not 67 resolved or approved identities. The exact 28 retained finding/obligation IDs are reduced to 26 rows in `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/family-findings-triage-v1/findings-matrix-v2.json`. Original authors, skeptical reviews, proposal bytes, primary capture times/hashes, source cases and occurrences remain immutable.

A source accession, filename, receiving dose, missing carrier, unknown pH or unspecified hydrate does not prove a distinct supplied preparation. Nor does it prove equality. Source-qualified partial proposals remain useful; overlapping candidates need a defined scope or the missing evidence before simultaneous installation. No unknown is filled by guessing. Source-batch water and final-volume instructions remain separate, and immediate-list completeness is independent of molecular grounding.
